items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
items.summary: Researchers introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a new method significantly improving KV cache compression for large language models, enhancing efficiency and performance.

items.title: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
items.summary: A new startup focused on developing and launching other companies has secured $100 million in funding, with a strategic emphasis on advancing physical AI technologies.

items.title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
items.summary: A new paper details SoL-Pi, a system that uses recursive auto-research loops to create more efficient and capable AI agents, pushing the boundaries of autonomous research.

items.title: Hex turns complex analysis into visual reports with GPT‑6 Astra
items.summary: Hex announces a new integration with OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, enabling users to transform complex data analyses into intuitive visual reports with advanced AI assistance.

items.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
items.summary: OpenAI has released a new framework outlining its approach to reporting and addressing instances of AI model misalignment, emphasizing safety and ethical development.

items.title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: This research proposes ActionPiece, a novel approach to action tokenization designed to improve the performance and understanding of autoregressive vision-language-action models.

items.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
items.summary: A new empirical study investigates various harness designs to optimize the effectiveness and reliability of AI coding agents, providing insights for practical deployment.

items.title: New experts join Google’s AI & Economy team
items.summary: Google's AI & Economy team has expanded with the addition of new experts, reinforcing the company's commitment to understanding and shaping the economic impact of AI.

items.title: New insights from Google’s AI & Economy ATLAS
items.summary: Google shares fresh insights from its AI & Economy ATLAS initiative, offering a deeper understanding of AI's evolving influence on global economic landscapes.

items.title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
items.summary: EvolveTrade introduces a novel method for refining policies in LLM-based trading agents through experience-driven learning, enabling them to self-evolve and adapt.

items.title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control
items.summary: Zing-0.5 is presented as a step towards creating playable virtual worlds that allow for real-time joint action and text-based control, enhancing interactive AI environments.

items.title: How to connect AI usage to business value
items.summary: OpenAI provides guidance on effectively linking AI implementation to tangible business value, offering strategies for organizations to maximize their AI investments.

items.title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
items.summary: Researchers present VC-Attention, a technique that employs value smoothing and softmax casting to enable efficient low-bit attention mechanisms in AI models.

items.title: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: This paper explores the phenomenon of length inflation in on-policy distillation, specifically when End-Of-Sequence tokens exhibit disagreement, impacting model efficiency.

items.title: Tilly Norwood’s press tour is going about as well as you’d expect for an AI
items.summary: The press tour for AI personality Tilly Norwood is reportedly facing challenges, highlighting the complexities and public perception issues surrounding advanced AI interfaces.
